g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Check Pension Savings and IRP Tax Credit Limits
Before Year-End Tax Settlement: Distinguishing 6 Million
Won and 9 Million Won
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-10
Distinguish the payment limit from the
tax credit limit
The amount you can deposit into pension accounts
and the amount eligible for a tax credit are
separate.
Check the credit rate by income
bracket
The credit rate is 15% if your comprehensive
income is 45 million won or less (or if you have
only earned income, if your total salary is 55…
Check whether your final tax due is
sufficient
A tax credit reduces the calculated tax by the
credited amount.
Check ISA maturity funds and the
payment deadline
The National Tax Service states that if you
deposit all or part of the balance into a
pension account after the ISA contract period…
